questions.stem: A 60-year-old man collapses at a shopping mall. Bystanders start CPR and activate EMS. On arrival, paramedics find the patient unresponsive, pulseless, and in ventricular fibrillation on the monitor. What is the next best step for his managment?

options.label: A
options.text: Begin chest compressions and administer 1 mg epinephrine immediately, then attempt defibrillation

options.label: B
options.text: Deliver one shock with a biphasic defibrillator followed by immediate chest compressions, then secure airway

options.label: C
options.text: Deliver three stacked shocks followed by pulse check and atropine administration

options.label: D
options.text: Perform synchronized cardioversion followed by amiodarone if rhythm persists
